ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-dominance of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to less than 3% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous low-intensity region covering both fluke lobes; high-intensity coordinate mapping is localized at the distal tips (left and right extreme boundaries) and along specific peak points of the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 18% of the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; peaks show pixel-amplitude variance of 8-12 pixels; serrations on the right lobe are more pronounced and irregular than those on the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave upward trajectory originating from the central notch and sweeping toward the distal tips; curvature is steeper on the outer third of each lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular pixel clusters at both fluke tips; left tip contains ~5 distinct points; right tip contains a larger cluster of ~12+ points consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three vertical, thin, high-intensity linear markings on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at the distal tips of both lobes; trailing edge shows irregular jagged patterns potentially indicating minor physical wear or historical trauma.
